Approval is strongest in Wyoming (+21), North Dakota (+16), and Idaho (+15), and weakest in Hawaii (−60), Vermont (−55), and Maryland (−49). All six states that voted for Biden in 2020 and flipped to Trump in 2024 are net-negative: Arizona −13, Georgia −21, Michigan −20, Nevada −21, Pennsylvania −17, Wisconsin −14. [...] ### Recent data
